description: ONS publishes global electricity load for Roraima for February 2022 through August 2025. The dictionary defines measurement timestamp and global load in megawatts. The provider links the publication to Dispatch 2,282 of 6 August 2024. These quantities support demand and generation-capacity studies for Roraima. The metadata does not state the time step, and the bounded historical interval must not be presented as a continuing national load series. Coverage is Roraima electricity system in Brazil. The catalogue lists CSV, Excel and Parquet files; files are free under the provider's CC-BY terms, with no version specified. ONS requires attribution and disclosure of changes. Data contents were not downloaded; completeness is unknown, and published values may be revised. Related ONS generation-by-plant data provide a comparison series.
